full_judgment: 4. Respondent No. 1's vendor named Doctor Altaf Hossain, represented by his constituted attorney Khondaker Guljar Ali as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.332 of 1991 in the Court of the then 'Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Khulna for declaration of title to the suit land measuring an area of 131⁄2 decimals of land out of 80 decimals appertaining to plot No. 540, S.A. Khatian No.1511, Mouza -Tootpara, Police Station and District- Khulna and also for declaration that the order dated 21.12.1975 passed in Revision Case Nos. 08 of 1974-75 and 21 of 1974-75 passed by the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) under section 53 of the Public Demand Recovery Act and the order dated 29.10.1976 passed in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 01 of 1976 was illegal ultra vires, void, without jurisdiction and not binding upon the plaintiff and also for further relief seeking recovery of Khas possession in the said land. His case, in short, is that the suit land belonged to Dhirendra Nath and for arrears of rent, certificate case no.1007 of 197-71 was started by the then Government of the Province of East Pakistan. The suit land was sold by the said certificate sale and the plaintiff purchased the same, vide annexure-2 and the sale was confirmed and the plaintiff got delivery of possession in the suit land, vide annexure-2(ka). While he was in possession of the suit land, the concerned Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) illegally started Revision Case No.08 of 1974-75 and another Revision Case No.21 of 1974-75 and both the revision cases were allowed by an order dated 21.12.1975. After that, the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) Threatened the plaintiff with dispossession whereupon the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.464 of 1974 in the First Court of Munsif, Khulna and got an order of injunction against which, appeal was preferred and ultimately the suit was withdrawn on the ground of formal defect. Hence, the plaintiff was constrained to file the instant suit. During the pendency of the suit, the additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Khulna being the custodian of the vested property dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit land on 09.11.1982.
